role: Extension of SleepDetailV2View holding the lower half of the Sleep detail screen: tappable stage pills with explanations, a per-component score breakdown mirroring SleepScienceAnalyzer.computeEnhancedScore, insights, the 15-night trend strip, sleep-structure descriptors and the age-group comparison card.
types: SleepDetailV2View.StagePillChrome: struct (ViewModifier) — pill tint/border by expanded state
SleepDetailV2View.SleepBreakdownEntry: struct — label/score/weight/ok of one score-breakdown row
SleepDetailV2View.TrendNight: struct (Identifiable, id = date) — one bar of the trend strip
toplevel: Only type declarations and the extension; no stored state, no #if.

flags.text: Score-breakdown math, insights, structure descriptors and age-norm rows have no unit tests; only the DetailScreenSnapshotTests render the whole screen.

units.does: Stage breakdown section: heading, stage pills over the night's minutes, and the expanded stage explanation, animated on expandedStage.
Shows the explanation card for the currently expanded stage.

branches.effect: renders explanation with transition; else nothing

units.does: Row of stage pills: Deep and REM when recorded, Light = night − deep − REM (floored at 0), and Awake (percent of in-bed time) only when efficiency was measured.

branches.effect: treated as 0 in the Light subtraction, so an unstaged night shows its whole duration as Light 100%
adds Awake pill with denominator inBedMinutes; else omitted

flags.text: On a night with no stage data (deep and REM nil — HR-estimated or user-added unspecified sleep) the Light pill reports the entire night as "Light" 100%, and on staged nights unspecified/user-added minutes are also counted as Light; the hypnogram labels the same minutes "Asleep", not Light.
Awake percentage uses inBedMinutes as denominator while the other pills use night minutes, so the pill percentages do not form one consistent breakdown.

units.does: Tappable pill button toggling expandedStage between this kind and nil with animation; a11y hint describes the stage.

branches.effect: sets expandedStage nil (collapse); else sets it to this kind

units.does: Pill content: stage label, formatted minutes, and minutes/total percent (0 when total is 0), with StagePillChrome.
Text colour per stage kind (contrast-safe text variants).
ViewModifier body: tinted rounded background (0.20 opacity expanded, 0.10 otherwise) and a 1.2pt border only when expanded.

branches.effect: stroke color at 0.6 opacity; else clear

units.does: Card with the stage explanation text.
Static localized explanation per stage (deep 13–23% typical, score aims ~20%; REM ~25%; light 50–60%; awake).
Score breakdown section: heading, the six component rows and a footnote about weights and the duration cap.
VStack of sleepBreakdownRow per entry, keyed by label.

Runs SleepScienceAnalyzer.analyze and returns six entries (Duration 25%, Efficiency 20%, Deep & REM 20%, Continuity 15%, Cycles 10%, Architecture 10%) with 0–100 component scores re-derived locally and ok thresholds (duration ≥85, efficiency ≥90, others ≥70).

flags.text: Component scores are re-implemented from the private analyzer helpers (efficiencyRatio, stagesScore, stageHalf, cycle/fragmentation terms) scaled ×5/×100; only the weight constants are shared, so a change to the analyzer formula silently desynchronises the rows from the ring despite the comment saying they cannot drift.

units.does: Duration component: min((night+nap)/max(target,1)h, 1.1)*100.
Efficiency component: 50 when efficiency unmeasured; else min(efficiency / (age expected efficiency or SleepConstants.goodEfficiency), 1.1)*100.
Deep & REM component 0–100: each recorded stage scored 0–50 by breakdownStageHalf, an unrecorded stage gets 25.

branches.cond: deep or REM half nil (stage not recorded)

units.does: One stage half 0–50: without norms min(50, share/targetPct*50); with norms 50 unless below-range with negative deviation, then max(0, 50 − |dev|*0.5*5).

branches.effect: returns 50; else applies the deviation penalty

units.does: Cycles component: min(cycleCount / max(3, floor(night hours/1.5)), 1)*100.
Row view: check/warning icon by ok, label, rounded score and "× weight%".
Insights section from buildInsights when sleepData exists.
Insights card with heading and list, only when there is at least one insight.
Card container wrapping insightRows.
ForEach over insight strings (id = string).
InsightBulletRow with the insight text at dt14.
Up to 3 insight strings: duration (<85% of target → short, >110% → catch-up), efficiency (≥95 excellent, <80 low, measured only), then the deep-share line.

branches.effect: adds low-efficiency insight; unmeasured or 80–95 adds none

units.does: Static range 0.13…0.23 used as the "typical" deep share.
Deep-share insight: above 23% "more than typical", 13–23% "typical share", below 13% or no deep data → nil.

branches.effect: "more of the night than is typical"
"typical share"; else nil (no insight for low deep sleep)

flags.text: The deep-share insight judges against the fixed population 13-23% band regardless of age, while the age-group card on the same screen shows the Ohayon range for the user's age (e.g. 3-10% at 70+); a 70-year-old with 15% deep is told it is a "typical share" while the card shows it above their range.

units.does: Recent-trends section reading cached trendNights; heading with count and the bar strip.
Horizontal ScrollView card around trendBars.
HStack around trendBarList.
ForEach over TrendNight (id = date).
One bar: narrow weekday, height max(8, score*0.6) coloured by ScoreVerdict, and rounded hours.
TrendNight identity = its date.

Static, nonisolated: for each recent session with a sleep snapshot of >0 night minutes, scores it with calculateSleepScore (0 on nil) and returns the first 15 (input order, newest-first from the archive) sorted oldest→newest.
units.entry: Run on Task.detached from withSleepEditor .task(id: trendInputsKey)

branches.effect: score 0 (cannot happen for a non-nil snapshot)

flags.text: No filter on sessionType or per-night de-duplication: every recent session carrying a sleepSnapshot becomes a bar, so two sessions sharing one night produce two bars for the same night.

Opened from MorningResultsView, recentSessions are only nights strictly before the viewed session (recentSessionsAsync(limit:before:)), so the "Recent trends" strip omits the night on screen; from the Dashboard it is the full archive head (all session types) and includes it.

units.does: Narrow weekday symbol ("EEEEE") in the app locale via a new DateFormatter.
Bar colour from ScoreVerdict(score:).color.
Sleep-structure section (heading + four cells) when night minutes > 0.
Runs SleepScienceAnalyzer.analyze and shows Cycles, Awakenings, Continuity and Architecture cells.
Complete-cycle count as text, "—" when the night has no deep/REM data or no analysis.
Awakenings word: ≤2 Minimal, ≤5 Few, else Many; "—" without analysis.
Continuity word from 100 − fragmentationIndex: ≥85 High, ≥70 Normal, else Low; "—" without analysis.
Architecture word: "Typical" when deep share ≥13% and REM share ≥20%, else "Atypical"; "—" without both stages.

branches.cond: deep or REM nil, or night ≤ 0

flags.text: Uses a hard-coded 20% REM floor and the population deep floor, while the Architecture score row beside it uses analyzer.architectureScore and the age card uses Ohayon age ranges; the same night can read "Atypical" here with a high Architecture score.

units.does: Structure cell: label above value on a card.
Age-group card: shown with userAge, sleepData and night minutes > 0.
Heading with age, comparison rows against Ohayon norms, citation footnote, and a footnote about unvalidated HRV-derived stages when present.

branches.effect: adds the accuracy-unknown footnote; else omitted

units.does: True when any stage interval with provenance .hrvDerived is deep, core or REM.
Rows: Deep %, REM % and efficiency against the age ranges / expected efficiency.
Computes Ohayon age norms via SleepScienceAnalyzer.computeAgeNorms, with deep/REM 0 when missing and efficiency 0 when unmeasured (only the expected ranges are used by the card).

flags.text: Re-implements SleepScienceAnalyzer's private ageNorms(userAge:sleepData:) (same deep/REM percent derivation and computeAgeNorms call).

units.does: Static: efficiency as "NN%" or "Not measured" when unmeasured. Also used by CitationQuickView.
Formats a ClosedRange as "(lo–hi%)" with truncated integers.
Deep share of the night as "NN%", "—" without deep data.
REM share of the night as "NN%", "—" without REM data.
Row: label, value, tertiary range text.
Section heading text at dt13 semibold with detailSectionHeadingStyle.
